description: This PHP file defines a custom Dashlet class 'MyClosedOpportunitiesDashlet' for SuiteCRM/SugarCRM. The class extends the base Dashlet class and provides functionality to display a dashboard widget showing the total and closed-won opportunities assigned to the current user. It includes methods for construction, display, options configuration, and saving options, and interacts with the Opportunities module and database.

classes.name: MyClosedOpportunitiesDashlet
classes.description: A custom dashboard widget for displaying a user's total and closed-won opportunities within SuiteCRM/SugarCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the dashlet, sets properties, and queries the database to count total opportunities and those marked as 'Closed Won' for the current user.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the dashlet HTML by assigning values to the Smarty template and fetching the output.

methods.name: displayOptions
methods.description: Provides a configuration interface for the dashlet, including title and auto-refresh options.

methods.name: saveOptions
methods.description: Processes and saves the user-defined options for the dashlet.
